taxon.wikipedia_summary: Vulpia bromoides, squirreltail fescue,:170-171 barren fescue:450 or brome fescue, is a winterannual grass species native to Europe, North Africa, and Asia Minor. It has been introduced to North America, the Hawaiian Islands, Puerto Rico and other places.
